text: I was hurt in a car accident in Melbourne. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

sections.text:
In Melbourne, contact **2–3 Victorian personal-injury firms for an initial assessment**, rather than choosing solely by advertising. Suitable options include:

- **Maurice Blackburn** — TAC and car-accident claims; advertises no-win-no-fee arrangements for TAC claims. Call **1800 111 222**.[1]
- **Slater and Gordon** — motor-vehicle accident specialists with offices across Melbourne. Call **1800 444 141**.[2]
- **Gordon Legal** — road-accident and TAC claims. Call **1800 21 22 23**.[3]
- **Law Partners** — Victorian car-accident claims and lump-sum compensation advice. Call **131 515**.[4]
- **Henry Carus + Associates** — Melbourne TAC and personal-injury lawyers offering a free consultation. Call **03 9001 1318**.[5]

Victoria’s **Transport Accident Commission (TAC)** generally provides no-fault benefits for injuries from transport accidents, including treatment costs and lost-income support; more substantial common-law damages may be available for serious injuries where another party was at fault.[1][3] A TAC claim should generally be lodged within **12 months** of the accident, so contact a lawyer promptly even if your injuries initially seem minor.[1][6]

Before signing anything, ask each firm:

- Is the case **no-win-no-fee**, and exactly what costs are deducted?
- Who pays barrister, medical-report and expert fees if the claim fails?
- Will the firm handle both your TAC benefits and any common-law claim?
- What limitation dates apply to your particular injuries?
- Who will personally manage the case?

If you have not lodged a claim, you can also contact the TAC directly on **1300 654 329** while arranging legal advice.[3] If you are in immediate danger or need urgent medical care, call **000** first.
